turns.question: For candidates who reached the interview stage between 30 September and 4 October 2026, what was the median number of days from their application to the interview stage?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it has no median and nothing measuring days from application to the interview stage, so I can't give that figure. The closest metrics are time_to_hire_days (average days from applying to being hired), candidates_in_stage (candidates per hiring stage, including interview, at the end of each day) and applications.
